title: Scylla Job File
description: Defines a Scylla pipeline job for automated pentesting workflows.

outDir.description: Output directory for pipeline artifacts (relative to workspace root).

quiet.description: Suppress VS Code notifications during execution.

variables.description: User-defined template variables (accessible as ${variableName} in step args).

scope.description: Additional in-scope host patterns for this engagement, beyond `target` (supports *.wildcards). Published to the governor so the egress layer constrains all traffic to the authorized scope.

cmd.description: VS Code command ID to execute.

continueOnError.description: Continue pipeline even if this step fails.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for this step in milliseconds.

expectOutput.description: Whether to validate that output was produced.
